name: acta/event-sourcing
description: CQRS and event sourcing building blocks for PHP 8.5+: messages, buses, event store, aggregates, projections and snapshots, built on PSR interfaces only.

suggest.ext-pdo_pgsql: Required by the PostgreSQL adapters (event store, projection store, snapshot store).
suggest.phpunit/phpunit: Required to reuse the contract test suites shipped in Acta\EventSourcing\Testing.

scripts-descriptions.check: Runs the coding standard, static analysis and the whole test suite.
scripts-descriptions.test:unit: Runs the tests that do not need a PostgreSQL server.
scripts-descriptions.stan: Analyses the library at the max level, then the tests.
